moonlight.configuration.dynamic_pack.des: Settings for the resource and data packs that mods using this library generate at runtime
moonlight.configuration.dynamic_pack.mul: Enables multi-threaded generation for dynamic assets (if supported). This could improve performance on systems with more cores available.
moonlight.configuration.dynamic_pack.fas: Makes the dynamic assets cache use a tree structure for indexing, drastically speeds up query time but could cost some ram.
moonlight.configuration.dynamic_pack.dum: Writes every generated pack to ~/.minecraft/debug/generated_resource_pack so you can inspect its files. Always on in a dev environment
moonlight.configuration.dynamic_pack.ext: ONLY for debugging purpose. Turns one some debug functionality like more logging or blocktypes_debug.txt, the file can be found in ~/.minecraft/debug/dynamic_registry_dump...
Enable this will list each BlockTypes' Children. The List of BlockTypes' children will be also in the same file via EXTRA_DEBUG. NOTE: To enable this, EXTRA_DEBUG must be enabled, too.
moonlight.configuration.dynamic_pack.mer: Merge all dynamic resource packs from all mods that use this library into a single pack
moonlight.configuration.general.global_d: Global datapack folder. A folder where you can store and load datapacks for all your worlds automatically. Set to empty string to disable
moonlight.configuration.test_category.te: A boolean feature: drawn as a check/cross toggle with its icon next to the symbol
A plain boolean, drawn as an ON/OFF button
A value that needs a world reload (shows a globe icon)
A value that needs a game restart (shows a power icon)
An integer, edited as a text field
An integer, edited as a slider
A double, edited as a text field
A double, edited as a slider
A percentage, edited as a slider showing %
An item picked from the registry, with icon
A block picked from the registry, with icon
An enum, edited as a cycle button
A value picked from a dropdown list
A regex pattern with live syntax highlighting
An ARGB color, edited as a hex field
An RGB color with no alpha channel

moonlight.configuration.test_bean.name: Name
moonlight.configuration.test_category.te: A codec object with a declared CodecUI schema, edited via a generated form: records and lists become navigable sub pages, ids and tags get registry dropdowns, and the map falls back to the JSON editor
A codec object LIST: the config's own page is the list, so entries are added and removed right there
moonlight.configuration.nested.nested_fl: A float value living in a nested sub category
moonlight.configuration.test_feature.fea: Only meaningful while the feature is on
moonlight.configuration.test_sub_feature: This feature reads false whenever the parent feature is off
moonlight.configuration.general.lazy_map: Prevents map texture from being upladed to GPU when only map markers have changed.Could increase performance
moonlight.configuration.general.maps_mip: Renders map textures using mipmap. Vastly improves look from afar as well when inside a Map Atlas from Map Atlases or similar. Set to 0 to have no mipmap like vanilla
moonlight.configuration.general.consiste: Fix minecraft entity shading to be exactly the same that blocks use. (1 for up,0.8 for north, 0.6 for west and 0.5 for down).This means that if you have a model and render it with a tile renderer or entity it will appear identical as one rendered via baked models.Using no gui will prevent it from changing item rendered in GUIs, in case you dont like that look.Note there is a known compat issue with Figura mod. Keep this True or False with that one
moonlight.configuration.general.tags_too: Show Item and Block tags on item tooltip
moonlight.configuration.config_screen.cu: Use Moonlight's config screen. When off, configs open the loader's screen instead: NeoForge's own (or Configured). Fabric has no such screen, so there configs can't be edited in game
moonlight.configuration.config_screen.sh: Give every installed mod with a config screen a tile, not just the ones using Moonlight. Their own screen opens when clicked
moonlight.configuration.config_screen.co: Draw other mods' configs inside Moonlight's screen instead of theirs (NeoForge only). GENERIC_ONLY covers just the mods that never wrote a screen of their own, ALWAYS covers every mod. Per world server configs are only shown while a world is open. Best effort: options we can't show are left as they are
Show a slowly panning strip of a mod's items on its config screen
